placements.why: The content concerns calibration records in the organizational record — specifically their erasure. No existing strata category covers this; 'Calibration' is the organizational category this content names.
placements.title: Calibration Records and Their Standing in the Organizational Record
placements.theme: The organization's calibration activities and how they are managed, asserted, or erased in the record.

placements.title: Erasing Non-Existent Calibration from the Organizational Record
placements.theme: The organization directs removal of all knowledge about a calibration that never occurred.
placements.why: All three segments cohere under the theme of erasing organizational knowledge of the Kestrelwood spectrograph's 88.4 MHz calibration — directives to forget and remove (src-1, src-2) backed by the assertion it never happened (src-3). No existing leaf holds this theme.
